metadata.name: Naver Papago Translate
metadata.author: kanaru313
metadata.description: Translates lyrics line by line with Naver Papago Translation API (NAVER Cloud Platform / Naver Developers). Renowned for superior Korean and Japanese translation quality.

apiType.title: Papago API service
apiType.subtitle: Select NAVER Cloud Platform (apigw.ntruss.com) or Naver Developers (openapi.naver.com)

clientId.title: Client ID
clientId.subtitle: Your Naver Application Client ID (X-NCP-APIGW-API-KEY-ID or X-Naver-Client-Id)

clientSecret.title: Client Secret
clientSecret.subtitle: Your Naver Application Client Secret Key, stored in system Keyring

honorific.title: Honorific form (Korean target only)
honorific.subtitle: Translates into polite/honorific Korean speech style (존댓말)

keepSymbols.title: Preserve empty and symbol lines
keepSymbols.subtitle: Lines without words (♪, ..., x2) are kept as-is and not sent to Naver Papago
